title: Jalan Alor ilikuwa tulivu zaidi kuliko Khaosan Road
label: Jalan Alor

text.I went to a famous place in Kuala Lumpur: Nilitembelea sehemu maarufu iitwayo Jalan Alor jijini Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
text.Before, when I went on a solo trip to Th: Nilipokuwa safarini peke yangu Thailand wakati uliopita, nilitembelea vibanda vya chakula vya usiku kwenye Khaosan Road.
text.So I thought Jalan Alor might also be a: Kwa hiyo nilidhani Jalan Alor huenda ikafanana na Khaosan Road.
text.Khaosan Road was the most fun part of my: Khaosan Road ilikuwa sehemu ya kufurahisha zaidi ya safari yangu Thailand
text.Khaosan Road turns the volume up much, m: Khaosan Road ina kelele nyingi zaidi.
text.Jalan Alor was very calm, and much quiet: Jalan Alor ilikuwa tulivu sana na kimya zaidi kuliko Khaosan Road.
text.Also, there are so many Chinese shops on: Pia kuna maduka mengi sana ya Wachina kwenye Jalan Alor.
text.Maybe because of that, the shop people a: Labda kwa sababu hiyo, wahudumu wa maduka walizungumza nasi kwa Kichina.
text.But sometimes, maybe because they found: Wakati mwingine, labda walipogundua kuwa mimi ni Mjapani, walizungumza nami Kijapani kisicho fasaha, kama kusema, “Kaka, njoo huku, njoo huku.”
text.It is a famous tourist spot in Kuala Lum: Ni kivutio maarufu cha watalii Kuala Lumpur, kwa hiyo nilikutana na Wajapani wengi na watu kutoka nchi mbalimbali.
text.I tried to forget with a beer, but 7-Ele: Nilijaribu kusahau kwa kunywa bia, lakini 7-Eleven nchini Malaysia huuza pombe hadi saa tatu usiku tu
text.The Kuala Lumpur sky was cloudy because: Anga ya Kuala Lumpur ilikuwa na ukungu kwa sababu ya moshi wa mioto ya misitu nchini Indonesia
